title: Digit Count in Range
description: Given a single-digit integer `d` and two integers `low` and `high`, return *the number of times that *`d`* occurs as a digit in all integers in the inclusive range *`[low, high]`.

examples.explanation:
The digit d = 1 occurs 6 times in 1, 10, 11, 12, 13.
Note that the digit d = 1 occurs twice in the number 11.

hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Digit Count in Range.
